description: RED-phase exemptions for ESLint mock-audit. Test files are exempt from specified rules when their corresponding business code file does not exist — the expected state during TDD RED phase (tests written before implementation).

exemptionCondition.description: Exemption applies ONLY when: (1) audit running with phase=red, AND (2) the corresponding business code file does NOT exist on disk.

businessCodeMapping.description: Rule for deriving the business code file path from a test file path.

exemptionCondition.scopeCheckDescription: The business-code-file-existence check is scoped to the same directory as the test file. If the business code file exists, the exemption does NOT apply — the test proceeds through normal ESLint audit.

rules.note: These rules are exempted because during RED phase, tests import modules that haven't been created yet. no-tier1-mock: imports may resolve to mock objects. no-skipped-tests: tests are expected to fail (RED). no-skipped-audit: the audit itself is deferred until GREEN phase.

implementation.defaultBehavior: When phase is absent or not 'red', audit proceeds normally with no exemptions.
